attr.title: Touhou Meishuugeki ~ Cursed Sweeper and Bewildering Parallel
attr.desc: Touhou Meishuugeki ~ Cursed Sweeper and Bewildering Parallel is a Touhou Project fangame developed by Drillimation Systems in collaboration with E. Enthusiasm. The game centers on a mysterious substance created by the Gensokyo Socialite Order under the name of glohm, who plans to use it to sabotage an upcoming autumn equinox festival hosted by Queen Marisa in Kozankyo in the Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo. Unlike the previous two SNES-style fangames, the graphics are more detailed complete with CD-quality audio.
